result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, Signable or DocuSign**, depending on how many documents you send and what you need the software to do.

My overall recommendation would be **Dropbox Sign for simplicity and value**, or **Signable if you'd prefer a UK-based provider**\.

Here's how I'd compare the best options in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

From approximately £11.67/month for one user, billed annually.

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable templates.
- Automatic reminders.
- Signed document storage and audit trails.
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans, according to current comparisons.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Signable**

(Best UK-based option)

Approximately £31/month for 50 envelopes.

- UK-based provider.
- Straightforward signing process.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go option available.
- Good for small businesses sending contracts regularly.

Website: [Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![Account: Docusign Inc](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dVhOhGt1QpkndwtGW47-sHNKllomPpU4vxs24pNswQkR4ZS5Rob9EH7Az_JSTVPfQ9TrCcH0e5oK9YdRNpm6RmBNsVkzxCsRHsY0XVby2paTjfNsyLWxXQIwIgoVkcHAN04Sy6nvt4MWYDJyoVDMUxLCH1igYXq2J2nv9XGNpFZ1f102xwVUVNokEDaHEjlQ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

From approximately £8/month for an individual plan.

- Very well-known and trusted.
- Excellent document tracking.
- Strong integrations with other business software.
- Templates and automated workflows.
- More advanced features as your business grows.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

Free tier available; paid plans from approximately £15–£20 per user/month equivalent.

- Create professional-looking contracts.
- Build quotes and proposals.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Useful for sales-focused businesses.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

Acrobat subscriptions from approximately £14.99/month.

- Excellent PDF editing.
- Electronic signatures built into the Acrobat ecosystem.
- Good document management.
- Ideal if you already use Adobe Acrobat.

Website: [Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/uk/acrobat/business/sign.html)

Prices are indicative, not guaranteed quotes. Billing frequency, VAT, user limits and signature allowances vary. ## Quick comparison

| Software | Best for | Ease of use |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Everyday contracts | Excellent |
| Signable | UK small businesses | Excellent |
| DocuSign | Professional workflows | Very good |
| PandaDoc | Quotes and proposals | Very good |
| Adobe Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Good |


## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

- Legally recognised electronic signatures.
- Automatic reminders for customers.
- Reusable contract templates.
- A complete audit trail showing who signed and when.
- Secure document storage.
- No unnecessarily expensive per-user charges.
- UK GDPR and appropriate data protection arrangements.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business

I have three questions\:

**1\. What type of business do you run?**

- Professional services / consultancy
- Construction / trades
- Property / estate agency
- Recruitment / HR
- Retail / online business
- Other

**2\. What will you mainly use electronic signatures for?**

- Customer contracts and agreements
- Employment contracts and staff paperwork
- Quotes and proposals
- General forms and documents
- A mixture of everything

**3\. Roughly how many documents need signing each month?**

- Under 10
- 10–50
- 50–100
- More than 100

With those answers, I can recommend the best-value software rather than having you pay for features a small business doesn't need.
